plan.title: Vendor revises after accepted counter offer

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enable the RFQ counter-offer control required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the setup.
Reach the buyer comparison grid where the normal bid and counter offer are managed.
Send the buyer's 90 counter offer to Vendor A's own bid.
Assert that the buyer's counter offer was initiated for Vendor A.
Have Vendor A accept the pending 90 counter offer in the supplier portal.
Verify on the buyer side that Vendor A's counter offer is marked accepted.
Confirm the accepted 90 is visible in the comparison grid before attempting the revision.
Have Vendor A attempt to revise the accepted bid to 88 while the round is live.
Assert whether Procol accepted the vendor's revised submission.
Return to the buyer comparison grid after the vendor revision.
If the revision was accepted, verify that the buyer now sees the revised 88 rate.
